analysis.reason: 직전 매도 판정 이후 2일 연속 하락 추세 지속. RSI 36.3에서 37.1로 소폭 반등했으나 여전히 과매도 구간. MACD 히스토그램은 -0.7555로 개선 없이 유지되며 약세 수렴 중. 5일 평균 대비 거래량 0.52로 위축된 움직임은 하락세 약화 신호로 해석하기 어려움. 주봉 ADX 47.9로 강한 추세 유지 중이며, 현재가(148.05)는 스윙 저항선(148.97)에 근접. 52주 고가 대비 19.8% 위치로 여전히 낮은 수준.
analysis.reasonEn: The downtrend has continued for two consecutive days since the previous sell decision. RSI has slightly bounced from 36.3 to 37.1 but remains in oversold territory. MACD histogram is holding steady at -0.7555 without improvement, indicating a bearish convergence. The volume ratio of 0.52 compared to the 5-day average suggests a contraction in activity, which is difficult to interpret as a sign of weakening downtrend. The weekly ADX remains strong at 47.9, indicating a persistent trend. The current price (148.05) is approaching the swing resistance at 148.97. The price is at 19.8% of its 52-week high, remaining at a low level.

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current Price ($148.05) vs SMA5 ($148.00)/SMA20 ($172.42)/SMA50 ($203.63): Short-term trend above SMA5 but below intermediate-term trends, indicating a bearish shift.
· Significantly lower than SMA100 ($208.50)/SMA200 ($202.61): Confirms strong bearish momentum in the medium to long term.
· 52-week position (19.8%): Current price level is historically low, suggesting potential for further decline.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI Trajectory (36.3→37.1): Entering oversold territory, indicating continued weakness.
· MACD Histogram Trajectory (-0.7555→-0.7555): Holding steady without improvement, in bearish convergence, no trend reversal signal.
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (Near Lower Band $125.77): Approaching the lower band, suggesting potential for further downside.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($140.85): Downside potential exists relative to the current price.
· Swing Resistance ($148.97): Approaching current price, potential for renewed decline if unable to break through.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Lower High continues): Weakening signal, confirming the downtrend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.52x): Contracted compared to the 5-day average, reducing the reliability of price movements.
· Current Phase Diagnosis (Downtrend): Sell entry conditions met; consider waiting for confirmation of further decline before observing.
